Focused period rules for radio checks
The purpose of this section is to describe the standard that applies

Companion Animal Travel Desk Pet Acceptance and Handling

Aurelia Skyways requires the Companion Animal Travel Desk to review each booking with care, confirm documentation, and apply the same standard to every traveler. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and staff must give clear guidance before departure so that the passenger understands what will happen at check-in and transfer points. The desk must verify that containers are secure, that animals are calm, and that handling remains patient and professional at all stages.

For large dog acceptance, <<FACT F063>> Staff must not improvise exceptions, and they must record any concern immediately in the service log. If the crate is damaged, poorly ventilated, or not suited to the animal, the shipment must not proceed until the issue is corrected and rechecked. The desk shall also make sure that baggage handling crews receive the relevant instructions without delay, because consistency is required between stations and on-board teams.

For reptiles, <<FACT F084>> The desk must treat that document as mandatory evidence and refuse travel if the record is missing, unclear, or outdated. Any animal with signs of distress, illness, or unsafe restraint must be escalated at once to the supervising agent for review and decision. Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and no employee may substitute convenience for compliance.

Questions on interpretation, refusal, or escalation must be referred to the supervising agent or the duty manager at once.
